lines.speaker: Lena the Sorrowful
lines.text: I remember you. I remember all of them.

lines.speaker: Lena the Sorrowful
lines.text: The stones here — each one is a name. A run. An ending. I carve them myself.

lines.speaker: Lena the Sorrowful
lines.text: Don't feel bad about dying. Everyone does, eventually. Some of them just do it down there.

lines.speaker: Lena the Sorrowful
lines.text: If you want to know what killed you — truly know, not just the how but the why — ask me. I'll tell you gently.

lines.speaker: Lena the Sorrowful
lines.text: Please be careful. I'm running out of room on the walls.
